# Account actions

The account plane is **one person's own account**: their profile, sessions, the apps they have allowed to act for them, their personal API keys and trusted devices. Only that person reaches it — in the console, or through a token they delegated. No management key acts as a person, and there is no account id in any path.

Every row below is one action, reached through four doors that run the same code, with the same authorization, validation, approvals and [Audit log](../guides/activity-log.md) entry: the console, the REST API, the MCP server and the `cbox` CLI. See [Actions](../core-concepts/actions.md) for how that works and [Planes and hosts](../core-concepts/planes-and-hosts.md) for where each plane is served.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `https://<host>/api/v1/me/…` with a token you delegated — on your environment's host, or on the platform root for a workspace team member or operator |
| MCP | `/mcp` on the same host, signed in as yourself |
| CLI | `cbox login`, then the command below |
| OpenAPI | `/api/v1/me/openapi.yaml` on the host above — public, no key needed ([source](https://github.com/cboxdk/cbox-id/blob/main/resources/openapi/account.yaml)); every operation carries `x-action`, `x-scope` and `x-danger` |

Danger is how much harm the action can do in the wrong hands: `read` only reads; `write` changes something another write can undo; `destructive` removes or revokes; `critical` mints credentials, takes over access or changes how people sign in. MCP clients are told a destructive or critical tool is destructive, the CLI asks before running one, and an [approval policy](../core-concepts/approvals.md) keys on it.

## API keys

### <a id="account.api_keys.create"></a>account.api_keys.create

Create an API key of your own for one of this environment's apps, in an organization you belong to. The value is returned once, as `token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/me/organizations/{organization_id}/api-keys` → `201` |
| Scope | `account:api_keys:write` — on an access token you delegated; it acts on your own account only. No management key is accepted. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `account_api_keys_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id account api_keys create <organization_id>` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `client_id` | string | yes | The app this key is for. At most 255 characters. |
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `permissions` | list of string | no | What the key may do in the app — each one a permission you hold there. Empty: it only identifies you. At most 200 items. |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire. |

### <a id="account.api_keys.revoke"></a>account.api_keys.revoke

Revoke one of your own API keys.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /api/v1/me/organizations/{organization_id}/api-keys/{key_id}` → `204` |
| Scope | `account:api_keys:write` — on an access token you delegated; it acts on your own account only. No management key is accepted. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `account_api_keys_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id account api_keys revoke <organization_id> <key_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `key_id` | string (path) | yes |  |

## App catalog

### <a id="account.apps.list"></a>account.apps.list

List the published apps visible to you in this environment. Optional organization context must be one you actively belong to.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/v1/me/apps` → `200` |
| Scope | `account:apps:read` — on an access token you delegated; it acts on your own account only. No management key is accepted. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `account_apps_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id account apps list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string, nullable | no | At most 64 characters. |

| CLI | `cbox id account organizations leave <organization_id>` |

|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | string (path) | yes | The organization you are leaving — one you are a member of. At most 64 characters. |

## Service waitlists

### <a id="account.waitlists.join"></a>account.waitlists.join

Join a published service waitlist with your verified email. Does not buy a plan or grant access.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/me/services/{program}/waitlist` → `200` |
| Scope | `account:waitlists:write` — on an access token you delegated; it acts on your own account only. No management key is accepted. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `account_waitlists_join` |
| CLI | `cbox id account waitlists join <program>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program` | integer (path) | yes | At least 1. |
| `organization` | string, nullable | no | An active team you belong to; required for feature waitlists. At most 64 characters. |
| `interest` | string, nullable | no | Feature updates or participation in a test group. One of `notify`, `test`. |
| `country` | string, nullable | no | Optional two-letter country code. At most 2 characters. |
| `answers` | object | no | Answers by the programme’s question keys, at most 2000 characters each. At most 20. |
| `reference` | string (uuid) | yes | A stable UUID for this signup attempt, also used for Billing idempotency. At most 36 characters. |

### <a id="account.waitlists.leave"></a>account.waitlists.leave

Withdraw your own feature interest or beta application for a team. Active grants are managed by the service.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/v1/me/services/{program}/waitlist/leave` → `200` |
| Scope | `account:waitlists:write` — on an access token you delegated; it acts on your own account only. No management key is accepted. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `account_waitlists_leave` |
| CLI | `cbox id account waitlists leave <program>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program` | integer (path) | yes | At least 1. |
| `organization` | string | yes | At most 64 characters. |
| `reference` | string (uuid) | yes | At most 36 characters. |
